grain: Declared fit cell; prediction sidecar additionally keyed by original obs_id
denominator: All declared sector×method×own/common×variant cells, including every unsupported cell. Primary d3/OLS, d3 low/high starts and d2 sensitivity retained

units.levels: reported monetary candidate units; no verified conversion or deflation
units.logs_and_residuals: natural-log points; nominal structural residual contains price/measurement/transitory components
units.counts: source observations, derivative risk intervals, distinct synthetic firms and draws explicitly distinguished

decision: Fit the pinned distinct methods under explicit nominal_development/syntheticpanel1; freeze within-cell log medians before optimizer. Restore native-log residuals; normalize by the sector-method-sample pooled dynamic fit mean. Only successful supported cells produce predictions.
missingness: Missing/zero/negative remain distinct; no imputation; unsupported statistical results remain missing and every skipped/failed obligation is retained
panel_mode: official synthetic_development; real linkage not required or claimed
